{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Once I would say I was a peaceful being, who had no interest in harming another living being. Now I prey on the Imperial humans, as they would prey upon others. Will I have a soul when I am done?|[[Charza Kwinn]]|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>}}
The '''soul''' was an element found in many religions and cultures, often thought to be a non-corporeal culmination of an individual's being, unique for every living thing.

==Specific occurrences==
===The Ewoks===
In [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology, individuals had a spiritual connection to a tree. These were referred to as [[Soul Tree]]s.<ref name="Wicket's Wagon">{{Ewoks|Wicket's Wagon}}</ref>

===The Mandalorians===
The concept of a soul existed in [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture. The famous Mandalorian war chant, the ''[[Vode An]]'', referred to the soul. Translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], the chant claimed that "Every last traitorous soul shall kneel" and "Every last traitorous soul shall fall.".<ref name="LucasArtsCite-Star Wars: Republic Commando: English Translation of Ancient Mandalorian Text">{{LucasArts|url=games/swrepubliccommando/downloads/mp3s/Lyrics.pdf|text="Star Wars: Republic Commando: English Translation of Ancient Mandalorian Text"}}. {{C|Extracted on 2005, site now defunct.}}</ref>

===The Mizx===
The '''soul''' was an element in [[Mizx]] mythology. The Mizx&mdash;native to [[Randorn 2]]&mdash;believed that every member of their [[Species/Legends|species]] had a soul. If a Mizx was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[ibliton]], a predator native to Randorn, the Mizx performed banishing rites to cleanse the soul. Otherwise, it was believed, the dead Mizx would reincarnate as an ibliton. The ibliton were believed to be avatars of [[Hershoon the Destroyer]], conjured from the Destroyer's own soul as he lay dying.<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]'', 39-40.</ref>
